sloka: एवम् उक्त्वा धनुर्मध्ये बध्वा मुष्टिम् अरिन्दमः ।ज्या घोषम् अकरोत् तीव्रम् दिशः शब्देन नादयन् ॥१-२६-६॥
transliteration: evam uktvā dhanurmadhye badhvā muṣṭim arindamaḥ ।jyā ghoṣam akarot tīvram diśaḥ śabdena nādayan ॥1-26-6॥

translations.english: Rama, the destroyer of enemies having said so clinched the middle of the bow with his fist and filled the ten quarters with the resounding twanging of the bowstring.
